title: Black Widow
statementMd:
Natalia Romanova is trying to test something on the new gun S.H.I.E.L.D gave her. In order to determine the result of the test, she needs to find the number of answers to a certain equation. The equation is of form:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a67291804bcb142d1b1db4b8216291ef927e26bf.png)

Where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e8ef042050cb082b91c8fb3ee50d2c87b494854.png) represents logical OR and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) represents logical exclusive OR (XOR), and $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ are some boolean variables or their negations. Natalia calls the left side of the equation a XNF formula. Each statement in brackets is called a clause, and $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ are called literals.

In the equation Natalia has, the left side is actually a 2-XNF-2 containing variables $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$ and their negations. An XNF formula is 2-XNF-2 if:

1. For each $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$, $*k*_{*i*} ≤ 2$, i.e. the size of each clause doesn't exceed two.
2. Each variable occurs **in the formula at most two times** (with negation and without negation in total). Please note that it's possible that a variable occurs twice but its negation doesn't occur in any clause (or vice versa).

Natalia is given a formula of $*m*$ variables, consisting of $*n*$ clauses. Please, make sure to check the samples in order to properly understand how the formula looks like.

Natalia is more into fight than theory, so she asked you to tell her the number of answers to this equation. More precisely, you need to find the number of ways to set $*x*_{1}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$ with $*true*$ and $*false*$ (out of total of $2^{*m*}$ ways) so that the equation is satisfied. Since this number can be extremely large, you need to print the answer modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

Please, note that some variable may appear twice in one clause, or not appear in the equation at all (but still, setting it to $*false*$ or $*true*$ gives different ways to set variables).

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of clauses and the number of variables respectively.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the formula. The $*i*$-th of them starts with an integer $*k*_{*i*}$ — the number of literals in the $*i*$-th clause. It is followed by $*k*_{*i*}$ non-zero integers $*a*_{*i*, 1}, ..., *a*_{*i*, *k*_{*i*}}$. If $*a*_{*i*, *j*} > 0$ then $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ is $*x*_{*a*_{*i*, *j*}}$ otherwise it's negation of $*x*_{ - *a*_{*i*, *j*}}$ ($1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ 2$, $- *m* ≤ *a*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ *m*$, $*a*_{*i*, *j*} ≠ 0$).

## Output

Print the answer modulo $1 000 000 007$ ($10^{9} + 7$) in one line.

## Note

The equation in the first sample is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/79796a51feb310dbecd7a236356d0599a2874c1d.png)

The equation in the second sample is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0bf5953fc0531771e961b12ae10ef2007a539f38.png)

The equation in the third sample is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b655529d1d18181e0e752f7c15a00d9a82ad2d53.png)
statementZhMd:
娜塔莉娅·罗曼诺娃正试图用神盾局（S.H.I.E.L.D）送给她的新枪进行一些测试。为了确定测试结果，她需要求出某个方程的解的数量。该方程的形式如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a67291804bcb142d1b1db4b8216291ef927e26bf.png)

其中，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e8ef042050cb082b91c8fb3ee50d2c87b494854.png) 表示逻辑或，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示逻辑异或（XOR），而 $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ 是一些布尔变量或它们的否定形式。娜塔莉娅将方程的左侧称为一个 XNF 公式。每个括号中的语句称为一个子句，而 $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ 称为文字。

在娜塔莉娅所拥有的方程中，左侧实际上是一个包含变量 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$ 及其否定形式的 2-XNF-2。若一个 XNF 公式满足以下条件，则称其为 2-XNF-2：

1. 对于每个 $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$，都有 $*k*_{*i*} ≤ 2$，即每个子句的大小不超过 2。
2. 每个变量在**整个公式中最多出现两次**（包括其本身和否定形式的总次数）。请注意，一个变量可能出现两次，但它的否定形式在任何子句中都不出现（反之亦然）。

给定一个包含 $*m*$ 个变量、由 $*n*$ 个子句组成的公式。请务必查看样例，以正确理解公式的形式。

娜塔莉娅更喜欢战斗而不是理论，因此她希望你告诉她这个方程的解的数量。更准确地说，你需要求出将 $*x*_{1}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$ 赋值为 $*true*$ 或 $*false*$ 的所有方式中（总共 $2^{*m*}$ 种），使方程成立的方式数。由于这个数量可能非常大，你需要输出其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

请注意，某个变量可能在同一个子句中出现两次，也可能根本不出现在方程中（但将它设为 $*false*$ 或 $*true*$ 仍然算作不同的变量赋值方式）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100 000$），分别表示子句的数量和变量的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述该公式。第 $*i*$ 行首先包含一个整数 $*k*_{*i*}$，表示第 $*i*$ 个子句中的文字数量。随后是 $*k*_{*i*}$ 个非零整数 $*a*_{*i*, 1}, ..., *a*_{*i*, *k*_{*i*}}$。如果 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} > 0$，则 $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ 为 $*x*_{*a*_{*i*, *j*}}$；否则它是 $*x*_{ - *a*_{*i*, *j*}}$ 的否定形式（$1 ≤ *k*_{*i*} ≤ 2$，$- *m* ≤ *a*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ *m*$，$*a*_{*i*, *j*} ≠ 0$）。

## 输出格式

输出方程解的数量对 $1 000 000 007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后的结果，占一行。
